description: This file defines a template class for handling enumerations with string conversion capabilities, including macros for enumeration conversion tables, and utility functions for conversion and comparison.

classes.name: EnumerateConversion
classes.description: A template struct representing a mapping between an enumeration value, its string name, and the length of the name.

classes.name: EnumerateType
classes.description: A template class providing conversion, comparison, and assignment operations for enumeration types, with support for string representations and lookup tables.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator overloads for copying from another EnumerateType, assigning from an enumeration value, or from a string fragment or C-string.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the enumeration value is set.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current enumeration value.

methods.name: operator const TCHAR*
methods.description: Converts the enumeration value to its string name.
